The '''Sphere of Imperial Intelligence''', also known as the '''Pyramid of Imperial Intelligence''', and later as the '''Sphere of Sith Intelligence''',<ref name="TRDC">{{TORcite|type=codex|The Reformed Dark Council}}</ref> was one of twelve [[Spheres of Influence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Headed by a [[Dark Council]]or, the Sphere was responsible for overseeing the main [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Intelligence]] operations of the Empire.

==History==
The Sphere of Imperial Intelligence was one of the twelve original spheres of influence. Historically, it oversaw various analytical and [[Spy/Legends|espionage]] departments, particularly the semi-autonomous [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] agency. The agency was led by a [[Minister of Intelligence (Sith Empire)|minister]], who reported directly to the councilor that occupied the sphere.

[[Darth Jadus]] was the head of the Sphere before his faked death. Upon his disappearance, he was removed from its head and replaced by his daughter and apprentice, [[Darth Zhorrid]].

In the aftermath of the [[Star Cabal]] Crisis, Imperial Intelligence virtually fell apart. The Dark Council then reorganized the crumbling organization into [[Sith Intelligence]], which, unlike its predecessor, was controlled by the Sith directly, as opposed to being an independent ministry.

After the Empire's defeat at the hand of the [[Eternal Empire]], the sphere was combined with the [[Sphere of Expansion and Diplomacy]] into the [[Sphere of Galactic Influence]] by Empress [[Darth Acina]].<ref name="SOTG" />
